description: Pass-2 implementation partition of the 74 required ports at 5ed97f7ab. Plans, not acceptance receipts. Largest groups first; green subgroups may commit independently.

groups.pattern: Main-owned selected request, polling and result/projection clients
groups.approach: One Main-owned client per captured runtime context, shared by every view of that API. Keep common physical/content observation at its existing owner; select request inputs, polling, filtering, presentation and originating action arguments. Replace/fence configuration-dependent workers on source changes and retire context subscriptions. First independent subgroup G1a: battery-wireless-devices, cloudflare-warp, ip-monitor, monique, whose only Main-owned preference is observation polling; do not duplicate physical owners. Remaining query/projection subgroups retain their field-specific ownership notes below.
groups.representatives: G1a: cloudflare-warp (milliseconds and installed guard), battery-wireless-devices (seconds and positive fallback). Query/result: latency-monitor and github-feed. Projection/action: mullvad and privacy-indicator. Individual unusual cases: news producer handoff, kde-connect singleton device selection, spotify-player OAuth lifecycle, assistant-panel/claude-code-panel shared conversation content, mawaqit protected calendar cache, slowbongo input lifetime.
groups.staticCheck: For every member, check Main context-keyed factory/cache/retirement; every runtime entry and Settings completion resolves its captured context; declared configuration-to-client/request/timer/projection/action mapping; no shared Main fallback for selected policy; no operational/content migration. G1a adds exact parsed Timer, unit/default/guard/refresh-owner checks for all four, plus missing-member/shared-reader/retirement negative controls. Source fingerprints only establish freshness, not this semantic contract.
groups.status: G1a: four poll-only members. G1b: ten query/projection members (latency-monitor, ramadan-iftar, ssh-sessions, mpris-lyric, syncthing-status, hassio, kubectl-ctx, update-count, keep-awake-plus, lyrics-fetch). G1c first green subgroup: port-monitor and mullvad; native both-scope representative and originating inert action outcomes supplement parsed field/cache/lifetime/entry checks. Remaining 22 required; broad visual/final acceptance pending.

groups.pattern: Originating selected action policy over one shared physical/application effect
groups.approach: Capture originating runtime policy/target through existing Main action and child factories; keep one real device/output/recorder/helper/content owner. Per-view browse/presentation inputs remain selected. Instance UI explicitly describes the shared effect, without dead instance controls or invented independent devices. Preserve existing native writers for action-result preferences.
groups.representatives: Capture tools: screen-shot-and-record and screencast-gif. Shared device/action: network-manager-vpn and ds4-colors. Individual unusual cases: 2-in-1-tools automatic sensor policy/restore writes, mpvpaper/video-wallpaper per-output automation and processes, music-search helper action/result ownership (reuse unchanged source-qualified proofs), usb-drive-manager automatic mount admission, noctalia-supergfxctl DBus lifecycle.
groups.staticCheck: Every public Bar/CC/Panel action edge and Main-created child receives captured selected inputs; no child falls back to Main API; writeback targets originating native API and fences retirement; physical owner remains singular; each affected instance field has a live consumer or explicit truthful shared-policy control; assert shared-effect explanation and preserve content/operational leaves. Reject omitted caller, shared-input injection and shared-writer mutations.
groups.status: All 19 G2 implementations select originating policy over singular effects. Steam retains one admitted typed geometry/dispatch policy through query, movement, show/focus and continuing-window stages. USB retains admitted automatic/action/completion policy over one observer; GPU retains typed context schedules and captured query/mode policy over one CLI/state/NotificationServer owner. Broad/final acceptance remains required; implementation counts are not runtime acceptance receipts.

groups.pattern: One daemon, automatic session policy or synchronized content resource
groups.approach: Trace which settings configure the singular server/daemon/automatic policy/content synchronization versus per-context projection. Preserve that shared lifecycle/content owner; select view/request policy where applicable and make resource-wide controls explicit in instance UI instead of admitting ineffective overrides. Do not reclassify stored configuration or migrate content.
groups.representatives: agent-session-status server and clipboard result projection. Individual unusual cases: clamshell inhibitor, hermes-agent managed bridge, niri-auto-tile subprocess, niri-screensaver idle owner, obs-control managed OBS, sticky-notes one synchronized notes/Gist identity. These resource contracts are not covered by a generic polling proof.
groups.staticCheck: Every field classified as selected presentation/request or concrete resource-wide policy with explicit UI and actual resource consumer. Check sole lifecycle owner, selected context propagation, retained operational/content schema and originating action writers. Reject dead instance fields, duplicate resource owners and shared-context view injection. Runtime each distinct lifecycle/resource contract individually.
groups.status: G3a implements selected managed-service/inhibitor admission for agent-session-status and clamshell. G3c adds selected Clipboard history projections and originating coalesced decode admission over one content owner. G3d adds selected OBS presentation/polling and captured action policy over one transport/status/managed-state owner. G3b Auto-Tile adds typed selected daemon/config policy with parent-death-bound Python descendants. Sticky Notes makes its one notes/Gist sync owner explicit in instance UI and retains credential/target/lifetime-fenced shared operations. Screensaver selects applied config/idle/hook/action policy over one session resource owner with captured probe and serialized writer lifetimes. Hermes Agent remains required. Runtime acceptance is recorded separately; broad/final acceptance remains required.

groups.pattern: View registered as Main, causing last-renderer backend selection
groups.approach: Move backend/context selection to existing Main-owned domain clients, never register a particular Bar as the global Main. Panel/popup binds the originating captured runtime context; common physical observation/actions stay shared and explicit.
groups.representatives: auto-cpufreq and battery-and-power-management; thinkpad-fan individual if its popup action ownership differs from those representatives.
groups.staticCheck: Every member has no Bar-to-global-mainInstance assignment; popup/backend obtains selected client from captured API; multiple renderers share one context client and cannot replace another context; check every action/configuration mapping, no physical-owner duplication, and shared-effect UI. Reject last-renderer and shared-popup mutations.
groups.status: All three backend-owner implementations have real Main entries, context-keyed clients and selected popup/Bar identities independent of renderer lifetime. CPU/fan observations and effects stay common; BatterySource is device-keyed and retires old subscriptions. Finite every-field/entry/owner checks supplement actual native representative and individual lifetime outcomes. Implementation status is not runtime or broad/final acceptance.

groups.approach: Pass captured originating API/context into the existing Main-owned window creation/toggle method. Explicit IPC retains plugin scope; no parent/window reaches into another view to infer selection.
groups.representatives: wallcards; somnus individual action-target proof with inert lock/sleep endpoints only.
groups.staticCheck: Every placed opener passes its API/context; every Main window/Loader initialization uses that capture, never shared Main API; shared IPC explicitly supplies plugin context; window replacement/close retains originating identity. Reject missing-opener and shared-window-context mutations.

groups.approach: Separate selected configured behavior from its actual state lifetime using Main-owned context clients; preserve protected timer/game leaves and originating native writers. Do not copy/migrate shared content. Truthful shared state UI where a resource is genuinely singular.
groups.representatives: Both individually: Pomodoro timer/auto-start/sound and Tamagotchi game difficulty/state/lifetime are not interchangeable runtime contracts. Reuse unchanged P169 input-path proof, not as selected-timer proof.
groups.staticCheck: Every duration/difficulty/auto-action/presentation setting maps to selected client; every operational write retains originating writer; all Bar/Panel/Pet/Debug/Stats paths resolve the correct client; no duplicate shared state owner or protected leaf reset. Reject shared timer/game config and shared-writer mutations.

groups.pattern: Module singleton session replaced by last Panel
groups.approach: Use context-keyed session/target/writer ownership instead of replacing Singleton API from a Panel. Preserve terminal content, credentials and explicitly plugin-level IPC shortcuts.
groups.representatives: hermes-ssh-chat individually: simultaneous contexts, connection replacement, delayed result and retirement.
groups.staticCheck: No mutable singleton API selection; session cache keyed by captured context, all Panel/actions/writers target it, explicit shared IPC remains shared; retired sessions cannot persist delayed results. Reject last-panel replacement and shared-writer mutations.

groups.pattern: Selected export/presentation policy over protected shared content
groups.approach: Carry originating exportPath/exportFormat/exportEmptySections and remaining selected presentation/action policy into shared Main content operations. Keep task/page/counter bytes and one content owner unchanged; prior P001 protection remains valid.
groups.representatives: todo individually: selected export command/output and actual presentation; reuse source-qualified P001 content-protection/runtime proofs when unchanged.
groups.staticCheck: All Main configuration readers traced to selected caller inputs or explicit shared IPC; every export caller carries context, protected content leaves remain excluded from configuration intents/reset, no migration. Reject shared export policy and changed-content controls.
